title: Cold, Warm, and Hot Startup with TTID and TTFD Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies cold, warm, and hot startup with ttid and ttfd?
options: Measure explicit startup modes and signal full display only when meaningful content is usable.
Mix startup modes in one average
questions.answer: Measure explicit startup modes and signal full display only when meaningful content is usable.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: A faster TTID guarantees the app’s first interaction is ready sooner.
questions.explanation: Calling reportFullyDrawn immediately in onCreate improves the recorded TTFD while leaving the user waiting for the same content.

questions.answer: TTID ends at first frame; TTFD represents the app-defined point when meaningful critical content is fully drawn and usable.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
